goals.goal: The company maintains continuous monitoring of its personal-data processing systems (customer account metadata and task data on managed-cloud hosting) for the five Art. 32(2) risk types — accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to personal data — and defines the moment of becoming aware of a breach to anchor the Art. 33(1) 72-hour notification clock.
goals.adjustment: Scope narrowed from a generic entity-level 5-risk-type monitoring to the company's specific B2B SaaS processing systems (8-employee, managed-cloud, two data categories); the 5-risk-type enumeration and 72-hour clock are unchanged; no enterprise-wide multi-system monitoring is required at this scale.

goals.goal: The product with digital elements (rule-based task management platform, web and mobile interfaces) records and monitors relevant internal activity — access to or modification of data, services, or functions — and provides a user opt-out mechanism; the manufacturer facilitates the sharing of information about potential vulnerabilities through a single contact address.
goals.source: Annex I Part I (2)(l); Annex I Part II (6)
goals.adjustment: Scope narrowed to a single-product B2B SaaS platform in the default product class (self-assessment conformity); on-device monitoring covers the platform's web and mobile interfaces; the user opt-out applies to the business customer's end-users; the vulnerability contact address is a single point for one product.
